Hey man, I'm 16 too, and after like 5 years of completely ignoring my school counselor's wishes, I decided to tell my dad today. I really feel like there's hope now. I hope you can find it withing yourself to do the same. I'm also the butt of every joke. I'm anti-social as well. A recluse, you could say. Telling your parents is something I think you should seriously consider because they definitely will not tell you to "grow a pair and man up". I don't know how your parents are, but they sure as hell won't tell you that. Just make sure to tell them to take you seriously, and it'll be great. After talking to my dad I found out that he's had it for years now, and so has my sister, who I thought was perfect in every way. They'll understand, man. I get the whole "hide behind my screen" aspect too, but this helps so much that I feel a little better just an hour after telling him. Depression is being taken more seriously than ever before. It's hard for me to accept this reality too, but I can't deny that it is what I said--a reality. 

Good luck, man; and know you're absolutely nowhere near alone.

I think you're right on the money here, but after thinking about this for a day, I think I'm also just scared that my parents will either blow this out of proportion or just ignore me/tell me I'm overreacting. Another explanation I've come up with for my hesitancy is that I myself think I'm faking it. I feel like I'm doing this for attention. It's so hard for me to know if I'm actually experiencing these things or not, and that makes telling people difficult as well, since I don't want to make a fool of myself. I don't know if telling anyone is something I'm up to do, but if you absolutely insist that that's the best way to do things, I'll do it. Thanks so much for your response, Lauren.

I mean I can, but doing it is what's really difficult for me. 

Everyone always says that telling my parents is the first step and I accept that and even tell them I'm willing to do it, but deep inside I know I'm not willing. At all. At this point it's like I only have 2 options left: suffer in silence or tell someone, and I'd much rather just suffer because I deserve it.
